question: Which vitamin is soluble in water?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin - C.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vitamin C** is a **water-soluble vitamin,** which means it **dissolves in water** and is excreted through urine if there is an excess intake. 
 
• Water-soluble vitamins are **not stored in the body **to a great extent and need to be replenished through** regular intake of foods** rich in these vitamins.
 
• **Vitamin D** is a **fat-soluble vitamin,** which means it **dissolves in fat **and is stored in the body's** fatty tissues and liver.**
 
• **Vitamin E** is also a** fat-soluble vitamin** that helps** protect cells from damage** caused by **free radicals.**
 
• **Vitamin A** is another** fat-soluble vitamin **that is important for **vision, immune function, and skin health.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vitamin D** is important for **bone health** as it helps the body absorb** calcium and phosphorus** from the diet.
 
• **Vitamin E **is found in **nuts, seeds, and vegetable oils **and plays a role in protecting **cell membranes from damage**.
 
• **Vitamin A** is found in animal products like** liver, eggs, and milk,** as well as in some plant-based foods like **sweet potatoes and carrots**.
 
• Excess intake of fat-soluble vitamins can lead to** toxicity,** as they are stored in the body for longer periods and are** not excreted** as easily as water-soluble vitamins.
